title: Connect your Lovable project to GitHub
goal: Connect the project to GitHub and find its link, so Companion can open it from a link

steps.find: your project in the Lovable editor
Git and then GitHub in the settings list

steps.say: Under Accounts, press Connect next to your connection. This makes a new private GitHub repository and keeps it in sync.
steps.find: Connect next to your connection, under Accounts

instead.say: No connection yet? Press Add connection. Only a workspace owner or admin can; ask them if you cannot.

steps.say: Open the repository connection menu and choose View on GitHub. It opens in a new tab.
steps.find: the repository menu with View on GitHub

steps.say: Copy the page's web address. In Companion, choose Open from a link and paste it.
steps.find: the address bar of the GitHub page
